node.statement: Writing Z=sum_{r,t=0}^{d_j-1} E_rt tensor Z_rt, direct calculation gives U_j(a,b)^* E_rt U_j(a,b)=omega_j^(a*(t-r)) E_{r-b,t-b}; summing first over a annihilates r!=t, and summing over b sends each diagonal E_rr to I_Lj. Hence the probability average is I_Lj tensor (sum_r Z_rr/d_j)=I_Lj tensor (Tr_Lj(Z)/d_j). Being an average of unitary conjugations, the twirl is positive, order preserving, unital and contractive; the formula fixes exactly I_Lj tensor B(E_j), so it is a projection onto that subalgebra.
